about_short_description.short_description: SAL is a cargo and freight company that provides transportation, logistics, and cargo handling services.

product.name: Airside Services
product.description: Services related to handling cargo on the airside of airports, including aircraft unloading, secure storage, and documentation.

product.name: Landside Services
product.description: Cargo handling and logistics services on the landside of airports, including warehousing, storage, and ground transportation coordination.

product.name: Special Cargo Handling
product.description: Handling of specialized cargo types such as live animals, pharmaceuticals, perishables, and high-value goods requiring tailored logistics solutions.

product.name: Value Added Services
product.description: Additional logistics services that enhance cargo handling, including customs clearance, packing, repacking, and documentation support.

product.name: SAL Logistics
product.description: End-to-end integrated logistics solutions covering transportation, warehousing, and supply chain management across air, land, and sea.

product.name: SAL Logistics Zone
product.description: A large logistics zone with warehouse hubs and facilities designed to support efficient storage, distribution, and connectivity in Saudi Arabia.
